examples.english: I drink coffee in the office.

examples.arabic: انا بشرب قهوة سخنة على المكتب
examples.english: I drink hot coffee at the desk
examples.transliteration: ana bashrab ahwa sokhna ala el maktab

examples.arabic: المكتب كبير وفيه ريحة قهوة حلوة
examples.english: The office is big and has a nice smell of coffee.
examples.transliteration: el maktab kebeer wa feeh reeha ahwa helwa

examples.arabic: صاحبة المكتب اللي قاعدة جنبي اسمها مدام فاطمة وهي اكبر مني بكتير
examples.english: My desk companion sitting next to me is Madam Fatma, and she is much older than me.
examples.transliteration: Ṣāḥibet elmaktab elli qa3da gambi esmaha Madame Fatma we heya akbar menni bikteer.
examples.storyTitle: A Day at Work: Different Generations

examples.arabic: وصلت منى للمكتب متأخرة خمس دقايق بس، بس معاها لمبة فريدة وقصة صباح مليان بتحيات الناس الطيبة.
examples.english: Mona arrived at the office only five minutes late, but she had a unique lamp and a story of a morning filled with the greetings of kind people.
examples.transliteration: Waṣalet Mona lel-maktab meta'akhra khams da2aye2 bas, bas ma3aha lamba farida we 2eṣṣet ṣabaḥ malyan be-taḥeyyat el-nas el-ṭayyeba.
examples.storyTitle: Mona's Journey in Khan el-Khalili: A Morning Full of Greetings
